description.narrative: Benin Power Compact - Electricity Distribution Project - Regional Grid Strengthening Activity: MCC Funding under the Regional Grid Strengthening Activity will support the replacement of lines, upgrading substations, installation of new switchgear connections and building new substations in three cities in Benin to support the interconnection of this Compact's investments under the Photovoltaic Generation Activity. Funding also supports construction of connection and network projects.
Commercial Capital of Benin, Cotonou
Commune of Parakou
Natitingou Division
Akpakpa, section of Cotonou region
Commune of Djougou

sector.narrative: Electric power transmission and distribution (centralised grids)
